component.name: MyLongboxDB Assistant
component.summary: Fill in comic book details for MyLongboxDB

description.p: MyLongboxDB Assistant looks up the details of comic books, magazines, and collected editions from a cover photo or a series and issue number, using an AI model from Anthropic or OpenRouter with your own API key. You review every field it found before anything is saved, and the results are written as a MyLongboxDB full export for you to import.
The Assistant never opens your MyLongboxDB collection, connects only to the provider you choose, and keeps your API key encrypted with a passphrase, or does not store it at all.
